description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Shadow King Mode I (Ardyn)], [Dual Accursed Avenger Mode] and [Dark/Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Dual Awoken Shadow King Mode I (Ardyn)
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Dark and Fire abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Dark or Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Accursed Avenger Mode
description.text: Restores HP for 100% of the user's maximum HP and grants [100% Critical 2], [Damage Cap +10000 2] and [Fire, Dark Ability +30% Boost 2] to the user when HP fall below 20%, removed after HP falls below 20% HP

description.name: Dark/Fire Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Shadow King Mode II (Ardyn)]
